title: Entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity enables near-decoupled polarization–strain behavior for high-density energy storage
abstract: Published online: 21 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79625-z Strong polarization–strain coupling limits the <mark>energy density</mark> and reliability of lead-free dielectric capacitors. Here, the authors show that entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity weakens this coupling, enabling ultrahigh energy storage with minimal electrostrain.
